E0980

A `jet os` host names a system the config doesn't define.

What

A `jet os` host names a system the config doesn't define.

Why

D-JPK-OSHOST1=C: the host selects one `system.<host>` contribution in `config.jet`.

Fix

Define `system.<host>: { … }`, or select one of the systems the config already defines.
